title: G&M Escavatori
description: Freelance project: a full-stack business website for a small Italian company importing and reselling Chinese construction and agricultural machinery. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, featuring a static product catalog, server-side validated contact form with transactional email, and SEO optimization targeting Italian search traffic. The project required working closely with a non-technical client: translating business requirements into technical decisions and managing scope independently.
